title.en: Generation, keeping and degeneration at two grains
title.zh: 两种粒度下的生成、守与退化

statement.en: At a fine and a coarse class and on branches, the pattern goes on along some branch or ends on every branch; generation and keeping exclude degeneration and can share a point; with keeping from some point on, excluded middle makes the regions cover; telling going on from ending is excluded middle.
statement.zh: 以细类与粗类同读、按分支读，样式或沿某支而延，或于诸支皆尽；生成与守皆排斥退化，且可共处一点；以守读为自某点起之守，排中使诸域周遍；分辨延与尽即排中。

laws.en: A carrying renewal, read at a fine class of parts and a coarse class of the pattern they make up, continues the pattern from one occurrence to the next while a part begins there; it is an alteration (火传).
laws.zh: 传：以部分之细类与其所成样式之粗类同读，样式自一事续至下一事，而一部分在下一事始；传即异（火传）。

laws.en: On branches: the pattern goes on along some branch or ends on every branch, which exclude each other; going on along every branch is going on along some. Generation (some branch renews without end), keeping (some branch goes on without renewal) and degeneration (every branch ends) are read so; degeneration excludes both.
laws.zh: 按分支：样式或沿某支而延，或诸支皆尽，二者互斥；诸支皆不穷即某支之延。生成（某支更新不已）、守（某支延而无传）、退化（诸支皆尽）如此读之；退化与二者皆斥。

laws.en: Generation and keeping can hold at one point, along different branches: a root whose chain renews at every step and whose other branch stays still is in both, the mixed region. On a single line, where each occurrence conditions at most one other, they exclude each other.
laws.zh: 生成与守可在一点上沿不同分支同时成立：一根之链每步更新而其另一支静止，即二者皆是，相杂之域。在单行之网中（每事至多为一事之缘），二者互斥。

laws.en: The split of a beginning. A carrying renewal begins no line of the pattern; where the pattern has a predecessor, a beginning of a part is the end of a carrying renewal; so a beginning of a part is, as far as can be refuted, a beginning of the pattern or the end of a carrying renewal. No order between the classes is assumed. Near-definitional.
laws.zh: 起始之分。传不起样式之线；样式有前处，部分之起即一传之端；故部分之起，在可驳之限内，或为样式之起，或为一传之端。不设二类之序。近乎定义。

laws.en: Keeping from some point on (后守): along some branch the pattern goes on and, from a point of that branch reached from the start, no carrying renewal lies on it. Keeping gives it, and so does 全守 with the whole line as the branch; it goes on along its branch, so it excludes degeneration; where each occurrence conditions at most one other, it excludes generation.
laws.zh: 自某点起之守（后守）：沿某支样式而延，且自此支上自起点所及之一点起，支上无传。守给出之，全守以全线为支亦然；它沿其支而延，故排斥退化；每一事至多为另一事之缘处，它排斥生成。

laws.en: The regions cover. With excluded middle as a hypothesis every point is 生成, 后守 or 退化, and on single lines exactly one; that this holds at every point of every model is exactly excluded middle. A line that renews once and then stays is none of 生成, 守 and 退化 at its start, and is 后守 and 全守 there: the gap strict keeping leaves.
laws.zh: 诸域周遍。以排中为前提，每一点或生成、或后守、或退化，单行之上恰居其一；其于每一模型之每一点皆成立，恰即排中。一线更新一次而后静止，其起点不在生成、守、退化之任一，而为后守与全守：严格之守所留之隙。
declarations: Becoming.«三域之定当且仅当排中»

laws.en: Telling whether a line keeps from some point on is deciding whether it stops renewing. On the steps under the one, read with the class of a sequence of truth values, 生成 at the first step is changing at arbitrarily late steps, 后守 being constant from some step on. Deciding 后守 for one sequence decides whether a given one ever holds (LPO), deciding 生成 gives only WLPO, and placing every sequence gives LPO.
laws.zh: 于一线上分辨其是否自某点起而守，即判定其是否止于更新。于一之下沿诸步、以一真值序列之类读之，首步生成即序列于任意晚处变，后守即自某步起不变。对一序列判定后守，即判定某序列是否曾真（对其之 LPO）；判定生成只得 WLPO；置每一序列于二者之一给出 LPO。

laws.en: The strong forms read the whole coarse line: 全生成 (the line never ends, and from every point it reaches a carrying renewal lies ahead), 全守 (it never ends, and from some point no carrying renewal lies ahead, renewals before that point allowed) and 有终 (some point it reaches ends, which is not degeneration) exclude each other and, with excluded middle, cover every point; with strict keeping the some-branch regions do not cover, and with keeping from some point on and excluded middle they do (law 6). Placing every point of every model in one of the strong forms is exactly excluded middle, and so is telling a line that never ends from one that ends; 全生成 holds along its line and an end reaches back along it.
laws.zh: 强形读整条粗线：全生成（线不穷，且自其所及之每一点，前有传）、全守（不穷，且自某点起前无传，此前之传不论）与有终（其所及之某点终，此非退化）彼此排斥，以排中律则覆盖每一点；某支诸域以严格之守不周遍，以排中为前提、守读作后守则周遍（律 6）。把每一模型之每一点都置于强形之一，恰是排中律；分开不穷之线与有终之线，亦恰是排中律；全生成沿其线而存，有终沿其线而回溯。
declarations: Becoming.«全生成之所及亦全生成»
Becoming.«不穷有终之定当且仅当排中»
Becoming.«全三域之定当且仅当排中»

laws.en: Each region is inhabited (an endless chain generates, a still pattern keeps, a short life ends on every branch), and the short life renews and still ends, so renewal does not decide the region. Telling going on from ending at every point, in every model, is exactly excluded middle.
laws.zh: 每一域都有实例（无尽之链生成，静止之样式守，短命者诸支皆尽）；短命者复生而仍尽，故复生不定其域。在一切模型的每一点分辨延与尽，恰是排中律。
declarations: Becoming.«延尽之定当且仅当排中»

laws.en: A coarse class constant under 缘 has no end from a continued point, so what ends after a continued step has a coarse class that is not constant. A sequence of classes, no order between them assumed, reads generation at every order, and generation at an order keeps the next order's pattern from ending on every branch.
laws.zh: 对缘有常之粗类，自有前之点无终；故有前而终者，其粗类不有常。一串类（不设其间之序）在每一阶读生成，某阶之生成使上一阶之样式不诸支皆尽。

laws.en: On the World model (occurrences: a step and a formation): carrying renewal steps into a formation that did not carry on as itself; under passing, generation makes carriers arise arbitrarily late; by names, as wherever each formation continues only itself, nothing generates; consumption held, a family drawn beyond renewal and stopped passing refute going on every branch; the relay renews and ends.
laws.zh: 在 World 模型的延续关系上（事为步与形成之对）：传是步入一个其形成未以自身延续之事；在传递之下，生成使载者迟迟生起；只按名读则无生成；所耗仍持、家族超出更新、传之止皆否诸支之不穷；中继复生而终。

laws.en: Read along renewing into under the one, renewal without end is going on along some branch, and ceasing is ending on every branch.
laws.zh: 在“一”之下沿复生至而读，«生生» 即某一支上之延，息即诸支皆尽。

hypotheses.en: None beyond the grammar: every carrier, every relation read as 缘, a fine and a coarse class; the covering laws take excluded middle as a hypothesis, and the calibration on a line reads sequences of truth values on the steps.
hypotheses.zh: 除文法外无前提：每个载体、读作缘的每个关系、一个细类与一个粗类；覆盖之律以排中律为假设，一线上之校准读诸步上之真值序列。

does_not_show.en: That generation here is the 生生 of life in the whole: it is the continuation of a pattern through renewal of its parts, with no premise on what the pattern is or whether its going on is good.
does_not_show.zh: 此处之生成即全体之生命的生生：它只是样式经其部分之更新而延续，对样式为何、其延续是否为善没有前提。

does_not_show.en: That the regions are decided: at a given point, whether the pattern goes on is in general not decided.
does_not_show.zh: 诸域可判定：在一个给定之点，样式是否继续，一般不可判定。
does_not_show.witness: Becoming.«延尽之定当且仅当排中»

does_not_show.en: That generation and keeping exclude each other where lines branch: a point can lie in both.
does_not_show.zh: 分支之处生成与守互斥：一点可兼二者。

does_not_show.en: That renewal is generation: a line can renew and still end.
does_not_show.zh: 复生即生成：一条线可复生而仍终。

does_not_show.en: That the three regions partition where lines branch: 生成 and 后守 overlap there, as 生成 and 守 do.
does_not_show.zh: 分支之处三域互斥：其处生成与后守相重，如生成与守。

detail.en: A short life of two occurrences renews (its second occurrence begins a new part) and ends on every branch (Map.Short.renews_and_ends_everywhere).
detail.zh: 两事之短命：复生（其第二事始一新部分）而诸支皆尽（Map.Short.renews_and_ends_everywhere）。

detail.en: A line that renews once and then stays (Map.once) is, at its start, none of 生成, 守 and 退化, and is 后守 and 全守 (Map.Once.not_generates, Map.Once.not_keeps, Map.Once.not_degenerates, Map.Once.keepsAfter, Map.Once.keeping).
detail.zh: 一线更新一次而后静止（Map.once），其起点不在生成、守、退化之任一，而为后守与全守（Map.Once.not_generates、Map.Once.not_keeps、Map.Once.not_degenerates、Map.Once.keepsAfter、Map.Once.keeping）。

next_delta.en: State the old map's regimes (renewal, consumption, capture, the five questions of 势) as regions of this map on the old base's readings, and the meta-attractor's reading of selection at the coarse grain.
next_delta.zh: 把旧地图的诸态（更新、消耗、捕获、势之五问）在旧基底之读上陈述为本地图之域，并给出元吸引在粗粒度上对选择之读。

correspondence.en: Generation as a pattern continuing through the renewal of its parts is close to autopoiesis (Maturana and Varela) and to the closure of constraints (Montévil and Mossio 2015), and the two grains to the levels of Rosas et al. (2024); the decidability calibration matches the old base's LastChange.lpo_iff_settles in form. Correspondences not proved.

history.en: 25 October 2026, board item OU6 (corrections to the grammar from the review of its sources, study section 400): the excluded-middle theorem renamed «不穷有终之定当且仅当排中», since it is about a line that never ends against one that ends, and the theorem for the three regions added («全三域之定当且仅当排中»); the higher orders said to assume no order between the classes; renewal without end and ceasing joined to 延 and 尽; the every-branch forms restated as strong forms with their quantifiers, as DEFECTS-FOUND asked from chapter 02. The claim is narrowed where a name or a reading said more than the Lean, and the new theorems are added; no other law changes.
history.zh: 2026年10月25日，工作板条目 OU6（据对文法与其来源之审所作之更正，研究第 400 节）：排中之定理改名为 «不穷有终之定当且仅当排中»，因其所论是不穷之线与有终之线；增三域之定理（«全三域之定当且仅当排中»）；阶之诸类不设其间之序；生生与息接于延与尽；诸支皆然之形依缺陷录（第二章）改述为强形，并写出其量词。凡名或读法说过了 Lean 者，论断收窄；新定理增入；其余之律不变。
